name: Jumping Chimps 2
summary:
Jumping Chimps 2 is a remake of Jumping Chimps on Applab!
We are here to make sure you have fun in are community based game!
If you any help or find Bugs in the game Feel free to join the discord in the game And dm me the problem. 
The developer team has Worked Hard and Long Hours on this game to make it as fun as possible!
